Ethan (partnerships): Heads-up: OrchestrateAI wants a marketplace listing + Redwood compatibility badge for their LangChain adapter + gateway plugin. Need a preflight checklist. @here :eyes:

Nina M.: I'll handle the marketing side (copy, logo, listing metadata). Need a short features list and screenshots. Deadline Wed?

Ravi S.: Engineering preflight 1: verify adapter uses our SDK call patterns or the unified gateway protocol. If it's calling raw endpoints, we need a shim. They said they support LangChain connectors + an HTTP gateway plugin.

Tina O.: Security review: we'll run a quick data-flow check. Ask them if any request bodies hit third-party telemetry endpoints. Also need their SOC2 status and a signed DPA for marketplace.

Ethan (partnerships): Good. Also coordinate demo infra: prefer Dedicated for predictability, but allow hosted fallback. We should publish recommended config snippet for customers.

Ravi S.: Draft recommended gateway env + mapping:
```
# recommended for OrchestrateAI demo
RW_ROUTING_POLICY=prefer-dedicated
RW_FALLBACK=hosted-latency-optimized
ORCH_AI_PLUGIN=true
```
This keeps routing consistent with our docs.

Nina M.: Marketing ask: 1-paragraph product blurb, 2 screenshots (adapter + orchestration UI), and a short quote from their CEO. Can we push for assets by Tue EOD?

Tina O.: Security checklist items: data residency declaration, telemetry opt-out flag, dependency SBOM, DPA signed. If any item missing we gate the badge.

Ethan (partnerships): Action items: Nina 1 marketing assets + listing copy; Ravi 1 eng compatibility + sample config + sample quickstart; Tina 1 security packet + go/no-go; I'll coordinate announcement cadence and confirm marketplace taxonomy. Sync Friday 9am PT? :calendar:

infra-bot: Note: created onboarding ticket #INT-3421 and assigned to Ravi S., due 2026-03-27.

Ravi S.: I'll spin a quick CI job to test LangChain 0.0.44 and LlamaIndex 0.7. Will post results here.

Nina M.: If security signs off, we can aim for a soft launch next Thursday with a co-hosted webinar. I'll draft deck outline.

Ethan (partnerships): Excellent. Tagging @orchestrateai-pm here to confirm assets and SOC2 copy. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
